about_the_game:
Idle Tree Keeper

Idle Tree Keeper is a cozy idle game about restoring life to a magical forest, decorating your tree home, and creating a peaceful world that keeps evolving, even while you’re offline.


About This Game

Restore a magical forest. Build your tree home. Relax while it grows.

Idle Tree Keeper is a cozy idle/incremental game where you help a small Kodama, caretaker of a sacred tree at the heart of a once-thriving forest. By gathering magical seeds, you gradually restore life around the tree, transforming an empty, silent space into a lively and chaotic ecosystem full of flowers and curious creatures.

The sacred tree remains constant, a timeless anchor of the forest, while the world around it changes. As you progress, the forest fills with color, movement, and magic, reflecting your growth and choices.

Customize your tree home

Your home inside the tree starts empty. Through prestige resets, you unlock and place furniture that grants permanent bonuses and new progression paths. Each piece not only makes your home stronger, but also allows you to personalize its look and atmosphere.

Choose which furniture to place, optimize your bonuses, and shape your own cozy sanctuary inside the tree.

Whimsical idle progression

As your seed production increases, tasks become automated and new upgrades appear. Unlock whimsical helpers and blessings like an arcane watering can, the favor of Pachamama, or a squirrel accountant who somehow makes forest taxes more manageable.

Progress continues even while you’re away, making Idle Tree Keeper ideal for relaxed, long-term play at your own pace.

Key Features

  • Relaxing idle gameplay focused on steady, satisfying progression

  • Restore a magical forest, watching it evolve from empty to full of life

  • Prestige system that unlocks permanent upgrades through furniture

  • Customize your tree home and choose which bonuses to activate

  • Whimsical upgrades and random events that boost production

  • Peaceful, colorful visuals with a cozy and slightly chaotic atmosphere

  • Original ambient music and sound design

  • Offline progress so the forest keeps evolving while you’re away

Ongoing Development

Idle Tree Keeper is in active development. Planned updates include seasonal events, new furniture, additional customization options, and expanded progression systems. Community feedback will help guide future content.

The game will be free to play, with optional in-game purchases. There are no paywalls, and all core progression systems are fully accessible through regular gameplay.

Add Idle Tree Keeper to your wishlist and follow the growth of a living forest!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.11 El Capitan or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (dual-core) or Apple Silicon (via Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with Metal support (e.g., Intel HD 4000 or Apple M1)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard or integrated
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (quad-core) or Apple Silicon (M1 or newer)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with Metal support (e.g., AMD Radeon Pro) or Apple M1/M2 GPU
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard or integrated
